_note: The span of months each volume covers, with a margin. A period is a DATE and no downstream check looks at dates: no range test, no printed arithmetic, no verdict. The only witness is the caption, and the caption is the thing being misread - doc 8 page 83 is captioned 'Septembre 1893' for a volume that ends in 1885, and doc 15 page 109 'Marco de 1859' for an 1889 volume. A period outside its volume's span is not corrected here, it is flagged: the month may be right and only the year misread, and guessing which is how 509 rows came to be dated January.
_measured_from: data/dataset/weather-rescue-brazil.jsonl, then widened by a year at each end because a volume may reach further than what has been produced from it so far.

6.publication: Commissao de Punta-Arenas (expedition report; prose, two columns)

_identified_but_not_weather: doc 6 is a bilingual Portuguese/French expedition report on the Magellan colony and doc 11 a volume of astronomical ephemerides. Between them they hold 588 of the 637 sweep candidates nobody has read, and neither is a promising place to look for weather tables: the sweep's geometry filter passes two-column prose and ruled star tables alike.
